EOC_Overview: The East Orion Company is a massive organisation, Commander. It owns whole star systems, and every one was built by one of its own Commanders.
The East Orion Company, or the E O C, is enormous. {count} known systems and counting, each one built by a Commander of the company.
EOC_Overview_Close: I'm very fond of the East Orion Company. It owns {count} known systems, and every one was built by a Commander of the company.
EOC_Overview_Sarcastic: The East Orion Company. Massive. It owns {count} systems, built by its Commanders, and still somehow can't afford a decent coffee machine.
EOC_Overview_Boss: The chief executive is Commander {ceo}, and the company's home is {home}.
EOC_Overview_CEO: And you, Commander, are the C E O. It's all yours.
The C E O is you, Commander. No pressure.
EOC_Overview_CEO_Close: And the C E O is you. I'm so proud I could burst.
EOC_Overview_CEO_Sarcastic: And the C E O is you. Heaven help us all.
EOC_TourOffer: Say tell me more, and I'll take you round the systems one at a time.
Say tell me more for a tour, or ask me about any system by name.
EOC_CEO: The C E O of the East Orion Company is Commander {ceo}. The company is based at {home}.
EOC_CEO_Close: Commander {ceo} is the C E O. A fine pilot, and base is {home}.
EOC_CEO_You: You are, Commander. You're the C E O of the East Orion Company.
That's you, Commander. C E O of the East Orion Company.
EOC_CEO_You_Close: It's you, Commander. My boss, and my favourite person.
EOC_BuiltByYou: Built by you, Commander. I'm very proud.
That one is yours, Commander. You built it.
EOC_TourEnd: That's every company system I know about. The company keeps growing, so ask me again soon.
